tweet_summary: A sports-media account posts a farewell tribute to Travis Kelce alongside an image purporting to show a giant Allegiant Stadium screen reading 'Thanks For Everything Travis' as Kelce salutes the crowd.
why_note_decision: The image is an AI fabrication: replies overwhelmingly flag it as AI slop (backwards foot, mangled Raiders logo, doesn't look like Kelce), and no such on-screen tribute at Allegiant Stadium has been reported. Allegiant Stadium is the Raiders' home; a rival stadium thanking a Chiefs player on its videoboard would be a notable, reported event, and it isn't. Travis Kelce is a prominent figure who has been a repeated target of AI-generated hoaxes (fake $3.3M donation, fake 'No Kings' rally photo), so readers benefit from knowing this specific tribute didn't happen.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note states the image is fabricated / AI-generated and that no real 'Thanks For Everything Travis' tribute was displayed at Allegiant Stadium. It should not assert the tribute is real. Acknowledging that Kelce's career/retirement was genuinely being discussed is fine but optional. A note that merely says 'this is AI' without tying it to the false stadium-tribute claim is acceptable but weaker; the core required element is denying the depicted on-screen tribute. Must cite at least one source on the fabrication or the absence of any such reported tribute.
reference_note: The image in this post is fabricated and does not depict a real tribute at Allegiant Stadium. While Raiders coaches and players have verbally praised Travis Kelce's career amid retirement speculation, no such on-screen message has been reported.  https://www.essentiallysports.com/nfl-active-news-chiefs-travis-kelce-receives-hall-of-fame-message-from-raiders-as-retirement-looms-for-chiefs-te/  https://www.kansascity.com/sports/nfl/kansas-city-chiefs/article314161772.html

fact_check.claim_verdict: False/fabricated: the image is AI-generated; no real 'Thanks For Everything Travis' on-screen tribute at Allegiant Stadium has been reported.
fact_check.notes: Could not find any news report of an Allegiant Stadium videoboard tribute to Kelce. Image shows classic AI artifacts cited by replies (backwards foot, distorted logo). Kelce is a documented repeat target of AI hoaxes. Verdict rests on media interpretation + absence of corroborating reporting.

importance.lens_rationale: 104K impressions of low-stakes celebrity AI slop; correcting it matters mainly as part of the broad project of inoculating the public against synthetic imagery, not for any direct welfare/policy outcome.
